_policy: POST-CUTOVER BASELINE SEALING. Every successful cutover invalidates the tracked reference it
used, because R(L) == A can only hold while A describes current production.
A_next = R(L_post) is accepted for ONE reason: L_post matched the materialized target that
was just approved. Never because it is live, never because it is newer.
FAIL CLOSED: if the most recent record for a workflow is not SEALED, the next deployment of
that workflow is refused until it is.

_note: Recorded UNSEALED because that is the truth. P7.5R deployed 45 nodes; the tracked
reference is still the 33-node pre-Model-B export, so R(L) == A cannot hold today.
This record is what makes the next deployment fail closed instead of comparing against
a reference that describes neither the old production nor the new one.
SEALING IT NEEDS A LIVE READ. The acceptance test is offline-computable: the approved
P7.5R target redacts to applyDelta(delta(A,B), A), because R(L_pre) == A held at the
time. So R(L_current) must equal that, and sealing is a proof rather than a rubber stamp.
